name: Yuuni
source:
"I demand a lifelong supply of meals as reparation. So please marry me, my prince~~☆"

A self-centered girl who does her own thing without a care of the trouble it causes to those around her. She used to be part of the Circus Group, but fell in love with Asagi at first sight and joined him. Quite a troublemaker.
